### D0D3

**Maximum ISO With Flash**

Msetter: Maximum ISO with flash. Auto ISO limit while a flash is on the camera.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 200 (ISO 200)
- Cameras: all

The M-EV1 and M11-P manuals give 3200 as the factory value (M-EV1 manual p.89, M11-P manual p.101). The unused profiles in a real M-EV1 export hold 200.

### D003

**Shutter Speed Limit With Flash**

Msetter: Shutter speed limit with flash. Slower lets in more of the room light.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (1/f s)
- Cameras: all

Unlike D00C, these numbers are option numbers, not shutter speeds.

| Value | Camera's name | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1/(4f) s | Four times that: 1/200 with a 50 mm lens. Freezes movement. |
| 1 | 1/(2f) s | Twice that: 1/100 with a 50 mm lens. Steadier. |
| 0 | 1/f s | One over the lens length: 1/50 with a 50 mm lens. Needs a coded lens or Lens Detection. |
| 11 | 1/250 s |  |
| 3 | 1/125 s |  |
| 4 | 1/60 s |  |
| 5 | 1/30 s |  |
| 6 | 1/15 s |  |
| 7 | 1/8 s |  |
| 8 | 1/4 s |  |
| 9 | 1/2 s |  |

### D041

**Flash Exposure Compensation**

Msetter: Flash compensation. More or less flash.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (0 EV)
- Cameras: all

Written in thousandths of a stop: -667 is -2/3 EV.

### D009

**Flash Sync**

Msetter: Flash timing. End of exposure puts motion trails behind moving things.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (Start of Exposure)
- Cameras: all

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Start of Exposure |
| 1 | End of Exposure |
